name: StickerPeel-TS-TW

frames.best_why: Frame 2 catches the sticker mid-peel with both the artwork and the curled flap visible.

tagline: The top of a round sticker peels up and curls back like paper.
summary: A black circular sticker with a white rim and a star mark sits on a dark stage; hovering lifts its top half into a curled white flap you can drag around.
appearance: A round black sticker with a thick white rim, a dotted inner ring, a four-point sparkle and the words SHIP IT in white. Peeling turns the upper half into a pale curled flap with a soft shadow.
behaviour: Hovering peels the sticker back partway, showing a blank paper underside; pressing peels it further and dragging slides the whole sticker while it tilts, then it snaps flat.
demo_content: Sticker text "SHIP IT" over "FRIDAY CLUB"; hint "Hover to peel it back, drag to move it".
search_phrases: paper flap lifting off a circle
interactive sticker for a landing page
use_when: A launch page wants a playful, draggable badge or sticker that rewards touch.
avoid_when: It needs a square image with transparent edges, so ordinary photos peel badly, and width is set in pixels.
customise: Image, rotation, peel amounts for hover and press, easing, width, shadow and lighting strength, start position, peel direction and className are props.
weight_why: A few image copies with SVG filters, a CSS clip-path peel and a GSAP Draggable.

a11y.note: The sticker is not focusable and its images have empty alt text, so keyboard and screen-reader users cannot peel or move it.

issues: The mid-peel frames show a large blank white flap with almost no sticker visible.
The component has no keyboard route or text alternative for the artwork.
polish_why: The peel and its soft shadow feel physical; the blank paper flap looks empty at full peel.
title: Sticker Peel Effect
